strings.name: Patrice Motsepe
strings.summary: A commercial and mining lawyer, Motsepe built a diversified mining group through acquisitions during South Africa’s economic transformation. He also invested in football and philanthropy. CAF president from 2021 and re-elected in 2025, he changed from ARM executive to non-executive chairman in February 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded African Rainbow Minerals and expanded Black South African business influence through mining, sport and philanthropy.

strings.facts.f2.label: Education

strings.timeline.t6.text: Acquired ownership of the South African football club.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Gold-mine acquisition
strings.timeline.t7.text: Bought shafts during low gold prices, financing repayment from earnings.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Law-firm partnership
strings.timeline.t8.text: Became Bowman Gilfillan’s first Black partner.
